reconstruction.scope: Hall of Remembrance (Ohel Yizkor), Yad Vashem: exact mapped square roof on a recessed rough fieldstone base, large blank concrete fascia, continuous shadow gap, depressed inner roof and thick parapet, recessed west-end front bronze entrance and small roof floodlights. Individual faceted boulders appear nearby; all LODs keep the stone/concrete contrast and off-centre entry. Interior memorial floor, flame, names/inscriptions and site sculptures are excluded. All other Yad Vashem buildings and memorials remain separate.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: Reuse original Protomaps20261020 and unmodified Mapzen201x201/6m hill. Uncovered forecourt provider internal[-8,14.2], datum805.5107922282233m. Original coarse slope partly buries uphill lower fieldstones (boundary ground reaches2.09m above datum), so buried base portions and exact threshold/accessibility levels are not certified.
